Flush over – · Leverage steady ✗ · Funding reset ✗ · Price confirms ✗. 0–1 green: wait. 2–3: a small starter buy at the bottom of the buy zone. 4: add the main part. A daily close below the plan's stop means the zone failed. Rules of thumb, spot only, not financial advice.
Green when BTC long liquidations are under $20M in the last 4h and under $5M in the last hour (CoinGlass).
Green when open interest has stopped falling hard: its 4h change is between −1% and +1% (CoinGlass).
Green at or below 0%: negative funding while price holds means shorts are crowding in, the classic spot-entry setup.
Green when the last closed 4H candle is at or above the floor of the 1D spot buy zone (Trade plan tab) and 4H RSI is back above 30. Price is above the zone: a pullback toward it is the better entry.

Squeeze over – · Leverage piling in ✗ · Funding hot ✗ · Price stalls ✗. 0–1 green: hold. 2–3: trim a little (take partial profit) into the sell zone. 4: take a bigger profit; don't buy here. Spot only: this means selling some of what you hold, never shorting. Rules of thumb, not financial advice.
Green when BTC short liquidations were large over 24h (at least $50M) and have faded (under $20M in 4h, under $5M in 1h): the squeeze fuel is used up.
Green when open interest jumps 2% or more in 4h: late leveraged buyers piling in near the top.
Green at 0.03% or more (three times the 0.01% baseline): longs are paying heavily to stay in.
Green when the last closed 4H candle is at or above the floor of the 1D sell zone (Trade plan tab) and 4H RSI is 70 or higher.
